content_sections.heading: VNIT Project Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Project Assistant: 2-year Master’s Degree in Chemistry or equivalent/related discipline from a recognized University/Institute with First Class or minimum CGPA of 6.5/10.

content_sections.heading: VNIT Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for VNIT Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at VNIT is scheduled for 04 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Assistant role, candidates must possess a 2-year Master’s Degree in Chemistry or an equivalent/related discipline from a recognized University or Institute with First Class or a minimum CGPA of 6.5/10.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Assistant post at Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the VNIT Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant role at VNIT will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for VNIT Project Assistant recruitment going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT), Nagpur, Maharashtra, 440010.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for the Project Assistant position. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position at VNIT is a contractual job, meaning the employment is for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.
